<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920437_theRebbe_883" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920437_theRebbe_883__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the concept of cutting a covenant in the soul involves drawing from a level above reason, unifying opposites, similar to the physical covenant of passing between the parts.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And from this will be understood the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the aspect of the soul,</t>
    <t s="2">for just as the concept of a covenant in its simple sense is that it draws from a matter that is above reason and intellect,</t>
    <t s="3">therefore no change at all applies to it, and it is established,</t>
    <t s="4">for through this opposites are unified,</t>
    <t s="5">and as explained in Likkutei Torah28</t>
    <t s="6">that by passing between the parts they become unified as one actual unity,29</t>
    <t s="7">in this way will be understood the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the soul, that for the unification of the hidden and revealed aspects of the soul, there needs to be the matter of a covenant, which is the drawing from a most supernal place in the soul</t>
    <t s="8">(in the manner explained above regarding the Torah).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the covenant before entering the Land of Israel was a special covenant needed for the descent into the lowest level of action, beyond the covenant at Chorev.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is also the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the aspect of the world before entering the land in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="2">"For you are coming to the land... and you will inherit it and dwell in it."</t>
    <t s="3">For it is explained in many places30</t>
    <t s="4">that the concept of entering the Land of Israel was the descent from the world of thought or from the world of speech to the world of action,</t>
    <t s="5">a descent to the lowest level, to a land that consumes its inhabitants,31</t>
    <t s="6">and since there needed to be a connection of the highest high with the lowest low,</t>
    <t s="7">therefore there needed to be beforehand a special cutting of a covenant, beyond the covenant which He cut with them at Chorev,</t>
    <t s="8">for even after the covenant at Chorev they were still the generation of knowledge32</t>
    <t s="9">(the aspect of thought or the aspect of speech),</t>
    <t s="10">but here there needed to be a descent to the lowest level,</t>
    <t s="11">until they caused the land to be very, very good,33</t>
    <t s="12">behold, for this there needed to be a special cutting of a covenant.34</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as there is a covenant in soul and world, so too in the year before Rosh Hashanah, a new covenant is needed to draw from the highest peak to the lowest, unifying all of Israel with Atzmus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, just as there is the concept of the cutting of a covenant in the soul and in the world, so too is it in the year,</t>
    <t s="2">for on Rosh Hashanah is the aspect of entering the Land of Israel in the year,35</t>
    <t s="3">and every year before Rosh Hashanah there needs to be a new cutting of a covenant.</t>
    <t s="4">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="5">behold, on Rosh Hashanah is the completion of the service of man,</t>
    <t s="6">for then the Holy One, blessed be He, says "Make Me king over you,"36</t>
    <t s="7">[for the decision regarding the creation of the world is through the souls of Israel, as the statement37</t>
    <t s="8">"With whom did He consult? With the souls of the righteous,"</t>
    <t s="9">and "Your people are all righteous,"38</t>
    <t s="10">and as explained at length in the Torah of the Maggid of Mezeritch, in Or Torah and in Likkutei Amarim at its beginning,39</t>
    <t s="11">that through the delight from the service of the righteous rising before Him, etc., like the parable of the father who pictures to himself his small son, etc.</t>
    <t s="12">And so it is every Rosh Hashanah, that the coronation is specifically through Israel],</t>
    <t s="13">and through this is the decision that He be King over the entire world.</t>
    <t s="14">And from the decision of Rosh Hashanah, it is drawn to all the days of the year,</t>
    <t s="15">therefore it is called "Rosh Hashanah" (Head of the Year) and not "Beginning of the Year,"</t>
    <t s="16">as explained at length in Ateret Rosh at its beginning,40</t>
    <t s="17">that it is analogous to the head which includes all the limbs,</t>
    <t s="18">and also afterward, when the limbs are each in their place, the head is what leads them,</t>
    <t s="19">for so it is on Rosh Hashanah, which leads all the days of the year,</t>
    <t s="20">and even extends into actual deed.</t>
    <t s="21">This is the concept of drawing from one extreme to the other extreme.</t>
    <t s="22">And also, the entire concept of the decision to be King is drawn through the coronation of the souls of Israel, whose root is above, even above Torah,</t>
    <t s="23">and from there it is drawn downward specifically through a ruling of law in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="24">namely the instructions in the Torah regarding actual deed,</t>
    <t s="25">and in order to arrive at a true ruling, one must exert oneself to reach the truth in its truth</t>
    <t s="26">(as explained in the continuation of the discourse for Rosh Hashanah that falls on Shabbat from the holy Rebbe, of blessed memory,41</t>
    <t s="27">and in the discourses of my father-in-law, the Rebbe, the Nasi of our generation, who fills his place),</t>
    <t s="28">behold, all this is a drawing from the highest extreme to the lowest extreme.</t>
    <t s="29">Therefore, there needs to be beforehand a concept of a special cutting of a covenant,</t>
    <t s="30">for through the cutting of a covenant, all of the children of Israel</t>
    <t s="31">(and "Your people are all righteous")</t>
    <t s="32">become one with Atzmus and Essence,</t>
    <t s="33">in the analogy of a simple physical covenant.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
